bookmark.name: Bookmark
bookmark.description: A saved web reference. Bespoke card view (favicon, title link, description, tag pills) plus Inline edit, Edit, View, Source — all schema-driven from urn:solid:Bookmark.

calendar.name: Event
calendar.description: A calendar entry — schema-driven Event with date/time pickers.

contacts.name: Contacts
contacts.description: An address book — collection of contacts as a card grid. Bespoke Contacts view (avatar grid with name + nick/email) plus Inline edit, Edit, View, Source — all schema-driven from urn:solid:AddressBook.

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: A fediverse-style timeline. Renders an OrderedCollection of Notes as cards with author chips, relative timestamps, content warnings, and hashtags. Companion to the Profile app.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Your card on the web. Beautiful schema-driven Person page with bespoke Profile view, schema-driven Edit, and Source. Open ?uri=<your-webid> to view any Solid profile.

todos.name: Todos
todos.description: A list of tasks. Built on LOSOS's bespoke todo-pane via the urn:solid:Tracker manifest.
